activities.activity: Review SOW, SWMS, drawings and associated Specifications.
criteria: Contractual accepted specifications & Approved SWMS
Current IFC revision of all landscape drawings confirmed
Planting Schedule and Planter Bed Qty Schedules reconciled against planting plans
Garden Beds on Grade (GA01 / GA02) & Turf (TU01)
Existing subgrade trimmed to levels permitting the full specified soil profile depth
Surface free of builders rubble, rock, contamination, weeds and standing water
Compacted subgrade ripped / scarified to allow free drainage
Garden Beds on Structure (GA03)
Structural slab laid to falls, waterproof membrane, drainage and drainage penetrations complete and signed off by others
WPM flood / leak test complete and accepted prior to landscape works
Inspection point and drainage locations confirmed against hydraulic documentation
Garden bed extents, bed types (GA01 / GA02 / GA03), turf areas and tree locations set out to planting plans
Bed edges true to line and matched to adjacent hardscape
Tree positions confirmed clear of services, pits, footings and lighting
Existing trees to be retained protected in accordance with AS 4970
Any conflicts with as-built hardscape raised as an RFI prior to excavation

activities.activity: Soil, Soil Improver & Lightweight Soil Mix
criteria: Soil analysis report supplied for each soil type (pH, EC, nutrient, texture, organic matter)
Site topsoil free of rocks, rubble, rubbish, weeds, roots and contaminants
Soil improver complies with AS 4454 and is fully matured / composted
Lightweight soil mix (GA03) to specified mix design and free-draining
Samples submitted and approved prior to bulk delivery
No substitution without written approval
Organic mulch complies with AS 4454, free of weed seed, pathogens and contaminants
Rock mulch to type, size and colour nominated in the Material Schedule
Mulch type confirmed against bed type on the planting plans (organic vs rock)
Sample submitted and approved prior to bulk delivery
Species, pot sizes and quantities as scheduled - no substitution without written approval
Stock true to name and labelled
Trees comply with AS 2303 - correct height / calliper ratio, single dominant leader, balanced canopy
Root systems well established, no root circling, girdling or pot bound stock
Free of pest, disease, physical damage and weed contamination
Nursery inspection and tagging undertaken prior to delivery
Stock protected, shaded and watered on site pending planting
Drainage cell, geofabric and root anchor system as specified
Tree stakes and proprietary tree ties as specified
Garden edge EDS01 - 5mm THK x 150mm H galvanised steel with 300 x 50EA3 stakes @ 600 c/c
Manufacturer technical data sheets and installation instructions provided
GA01 / GA02 - Beds on Natural Ground
200mm soil improver rotary hoed into 300mm site topsoil
GA03 - Beds on Structure
Lightweight soil mix minimum 300mm depth (450mm nominal bed depth)
Minimum 1000mm lightweight soil mix depth at tree locations
TU01 - Turf Areas
100mm soil improver rotary hoed into 100mm site topsoil
General
Soil placed in even layers and lightly consolidated - no over-compaction or trafficking when wet
No rocks, rubble, rubbish or foreign material within the profile
Finished soil level set to achieve mulch / turf level 25mm below surrounding hardscape typical
Beds graded evenly with no depressions, ponding or high spots
GA02 - Basin Garden Bed
Batters graded at maximum 1:3 slope
Minimum 600mm flat zone maintained at base of basin
Mulch / soil berm formed as detailed
Mortared rock pitching installed to pit surround
Overflow pit set to level per civil documentation - no obstruction to inlet
Edging
Garden edge installed true to line and level, stakes at 600 c/c, top edge flush with adjacent finished levels
Planting hole provides minimum 300mm clearance around the root ball
Base of hole filled with existing site soil and soil improver as specified, free of rocks, rubble and rubbish
Tree set plumb with root flare at finished soil level - not planted proud or buried
Backfill with topsoil lightly compacted in 150mm layers, no air voids
Root anchor system installed to manufacturer specification where detailed
Trees under 500L - 3 no. proprietary tree ties in figure of 8 configuration placed at one third height of tree from ground
Stakes neatly cut off level 200mm above tree ties post installation
Ties firm but not restricting or damaging the trunk
Mulch / soil berm formed around the tree
Trees on structure - minimum 1000mm soil depth confirmed at tree location
Tree watered in immediately after planting
HOLD POINT - first tree pit of each type to be inspected prior to bulk planting
Species, pot size and planting rate (per m2) as scheduled for each bed
Meadow mixes set out to the scheduled proportion of mix and randomly distributed - no obvious rows or clumping
Quantities reconciled against the Planter Bed Qty Schedules for each bed
Plants watered thoroughly prior to planting
Root balls teased where required, plants set at correct depth with top of root ball flush with finished soil level
Holes backfilled and firmed with no air voids
Plants set out clear of bed edges, hardscape and services to allow for mature spread
Planted areas watered in immediately after planting
Turf supplied fresh, laid within 24 hours of delivery, kept moist prior to laying
Prepared soil graded smooth, even and free of stones and debris
Turf laid with staggered close butt joints - no gaps, overlaps or exposed soil
Turf rolled / tamped to ensure full contact with the soil profile
Finished turf level flush with adjacent hardscape and edging
Turf watered thoroughly immediately after laying
No trafficking of newly laid turf
Irrigation complete, pressure tested and commissioned prior to mulching
Mulch placed to 75mm minimum depth, uniform across the bed
Mulch kept clear of and sloped toward the base of plant stems
Raked to an even surface flush with the surrounding design levels
Mulch level 25mm below surrounding hardscape typical
Irrigation installed, pressure tested and commissioned in accordance with the irrigation documentation / ITP
Drippers / emitters located at plant positions and not displaced during mulching
Controller programmed and watering schedule handed over
No leaks, weeping or damage to the system following mulching
Plant species, pot sizes and quantities verified against the Planting Schedule and Planter Bed Qty Schedules
All plants healthy, plumb, firm in the ground and free of damage, pest and disease
No gaps, bare patches or missed areas within beds
Mulch depth, type and finished levels uniform throughout and 25mm below adjacent hardscape
Beds free of weeds, rubbish, debris and construction spoil
Bed edging true to line and level with no damage
No ponding within beds, basins or turf areas
Turf knitted, evenly laid, flush with adjacent surfaces and free of gaps
Trees plumb, securely staked / anchored, ties correctly fitted and not causing damage
Irrigation operational across the full works area
Surrounding hardscape cleaned down and free of soil and mulch staining
